functions.name: GetChargeState
functions.description: Returns the current battery and charger state as a table with power, voltage, percentage, and charger status fields.

returns.description: Table fields: plugged_in (boolean), battery_voltage_mv (int32), charger_state (string: off|precharge|normal_charge|finishing_charge), battery_percent (int32), charger_main_fsm (string), charger_main_fsm_raw (int32), charger_jeita_region (string), charger_die_temp_limit_exceeded (boolean), charger_ok_irq_status (int32), charger_nok_irq_status (int32)

functions.example:
local state = Battery.GetChargeState()
print(string.format('%d%% %dmV', state.battery_percent, state.battery_voltage_mv))
if state.charger_state ~= 'off' then
  print('charger: ' .. state.charger_state)
end

parameters.description: Palette index 0-15. Defaults to the current pen colour.

functions.name: btn
functions.description: Is button i held this frame? Omit i to get a bitfield of all buttons. Buttons: 0 left, 1 right, 2 up, 3 down, 4 O, 5 X. Only player 0 is wired to a device.

parameters.name: i
parameters.description: Button index 0-5. Omit to receive a bitfield of every button.

parameters.name: p
parameters.description: Player index. Only player 0 is wired to a device; other players always read as not pressed.

returns.description: True while the button is held. With no index, a bitfield with one bit set per held button.

functions.name: btnp
functions.description: Was button i pressed this frame? Omit i to get a bitfield of all buttons. Buttons: 0 left, 1 right, 2 up, 3 down, 4 O, 5 X. Only player 0 is wired to a device.

parameters.name: i
parameters.description: Button index 0-5. Omit to receive a bitfield of every button.

parameters.name: p
parameters.description: Player index. Only player 0 is wired to a device; other players always read as not pressed.

returns.description: True on the frame the button went down. With no index, a bitfield with one bit set per newly pressed button.

parameters.name: c
parameters.description: Palette index 0-15 to fill with. Defaults to 0 (black).

functions.name: pal
functions.description: Set palette mapping. pal(c0, c1, [p]) remaps one colour, pal(tbl, [p]) remaps an entry per table key, pal(p) resets one palette and pal() resets them all

parameters.name: c0
parameters.description: Palette index to remap, or a table of mappings keyed by index. Given alone it is the palette to reset. Omit all arguments to reset every palette, including transparency.

parameters.name: c1
parameters.description: Palette index to draw in its place. May be an extended colour 128-143 when p is 1.

parameters.name: p
parameters.description: 0 (default) for the draw palette, 1 for the screen palette, which also recolours pixels already drawn.

returns.description: The mapping c0 had before the call, so a cart can save a palette it is about to change.

parameters.name: c
parameters.description: Palette index to change. Omit all arguments to reset so only colour 0 is transparent.

parameters.name: t
parameters.description: True to skip this colour when drawing sprites.

parameters.name: mask
parameters.description: Bitfield of channels to reserve for music.

parameters.description: Channel 0-3, or -1 to pick a free one.
